topics.title: Verducatib (1397-0032) ANCA-AV – Global Go/No-Go Decision Pending Q1 2026

background.text: Development of ANCA-AV indication for study 1397-0032 was terminated in Sep 2024 with timeline mapped. Purpose is to support line extension and extend market exclusivity. Global Go or No-go decision is expected Q1 2026; discussion is ongoing globally. Timeline is TBD.
